title: Pablo Castro Sánchez-Bermejo
text: I am a postdoctoral researcher in the Misión Biológica de Galicia (MBG-CSIC). My research focuses on understanding the responses of biodiversity and its effects on ecosystem function, with special focus on the traits of the species. Further, I have great interest on the use of illustrations and data visualization to communicate science
